name: Figure-Four Glute Stretch

instructions.description: Sit tall on a stable chair.
Place one ankle across the opposite thigh.
Hinge forward slightly until a mild glute stretch is felt.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Figure-Four Glute Stretch — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Keep the movement gentle and the chair stable.
